title: Whatever Pleases You Comes To Pass
summary: Hukam is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive
lifeApplication: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive
source.lifeApplication: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.
